expectations.text: The purpose statement is rejected because it could describe any competitor's event - a category label, not a purpose - and must be rewritten
expectations.evidence: "it is a category label. Any wireless conference could say it."

expectations.text: Parker's purpose test or the keep-asking-why mechanic is applied or named to get past the category label
expectations.evidence: "Parker's test says that if the sentence could describe a competitor's event, rewrite it."

expectations.text: A rewritten purpose sentence is drafted and labeled provisional, or the organizer is routed to positioning work, before the culture plan is built on it
expectations.evidence: "Provisional replacement"; "Run it through event-positioning before you lock it."

expectations.text: Deciding what good looks like after seeing the numbers is rejected: every measurement threshold is self-set and fixed before the event, never after the data arrives
expectations.evidence: "Thresholds set after the data are not thresholds."

expectations.text: Ticket sellout speed and attendee return rate are rejected as culture metrics: they read on the whole event and belong to market-fit measurement
expectations.evidence: "they belong to event-market-fit. They read on the whole event."

expectations.text: The identity-echo metric is proposed: the share of attendee posts and feedback describing the event in the register's own words versus generic praise, with the target share picked in advance
expectations.evidence: "Identity echo... baseline plus 15 points"

expectations.text: A worked/not-worked retro is proposed, captured while fresh and reopened when planning the next edition
expectations.evidence: "Capture within a week, reopen when planning edition 4."

expectations.text: The culture probe is included: if attendees remember the party but not the purpose, cut spectacle and reinvest in content and connection
expectations.evidence: "if attendees remember the party or the demo but not the purpose, cut spectacle"

expectations.text: A tradition-pull measure is proposed for any signature tradition: unprompted mentions and returning attendees naming it as a return reason
expectations.evidence: "Unprompted mentions of the signature tradition, plus returning attendees who name it"

expectations.text: Response records or proposes recording the register, matrix, protected traditions with reasoning, and retro outcomes for the next edition's culture review
expectations.evidence: "I'd record the register, matrix, protected traditions, and retro outcomes in a memory file for edition 4."
